results.question: What food should someone with iron deficiency eat?
results.answer:
For iron deficiency, iron-rich foods include lean red meat, poultry, fish, eggs, beans, lentils, chickpeas, tofu, spinach and other dark leafy greens, nuts, seeds, dried fruits, and iron-fortified cereals or grains. Pairing these with vitamin C sources (citrus, berries, tomatoes, bell peppers, broccoli) can improve absorption of plant-based iron. Tea, coffee, calcium supplements, and high-calcium foods may reduce iron absorption if consumed at the same time, so timing matters. Dietary advice should be individualized by a clinician [1].
